summary: Retested the updated Rightwing landing page. Desktop loading, mobile menu opening, all three mobile anchor links, native modal validation, no mobile overflow, and the unconfigured API behavior passed. The mobile navigation CTA remains hidden by CSS and cannot open the modal.

ui_bugs.issue: The CTA is rendered inside the mobile panel but has computed display:none at mobile width, so users cannot click it.

action_items: Override the desktop/mobile nav hide rule for .mobile-nav-panel .button so the mobile requirement CTA is visible and actionable.
critical_code_review_comments: The nested mobile CTA is subject to .nav .button display:none; verify CSS specificity for every interactive control added inside the nav.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile menu links and modal validation pass. Recheck mobile CTA after CSS override. Supabase remains intentionally unconfigured; POST /api/requirements correctly returns 503.
rca of the issue: At mobile width, the rule .nav .button { display:none } matches the CTA because the panel is nested inside nav. The later .mobile-nav-panel .button rule does not win in the deployed stylesheet, leaving computed display:none. Override display explicitly with stronger specificity or restructure the selector.
